title: Royal Harmony Lentekrans Linne
text1:
The association was founded in 1873 as a choir, transformed into a brass band in 1886, and eventually became a harmony orchestra in 1911.
Until the beginning of this century, the orchestra participated in competitions at a high level, including federation contests. Nowadays, however, it prefers to perform beautiful concerts that are accessible to a wider audience. The orchestra still strives to bring something innovative, such as performances with a large choir, in a cathedral, or based on a specific theme.
In addition, it contributes to several outdoor events, including the annual open-air Mass, the Sinterklaas parade, and All Saints’ Day celebrations.

Special attention is given to young people, as they are the future of the association!
For this reason, there is a beginner group for young musicians, after which they progress to the youth orchestra, known as LOL (Lentekrans Training Orchestra Linne).
Would you like to learn more about this wonderful association? Feel free to explore the rest of this website, and do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions!
text2: We are a group of people who share a passion: making music together in a responsible way under the guidance of skilled professionals. Everyone can participate at their own level. From beginner musicians to seasoned players, there is a place for everyone. Making music together is our guiding principle, with emphasis on "together." To give everyone the opportunity to participate, we have created a "path to making music."̀
heading3: Discover the Passion of Making Music Together
text3: This website highlights all these sections. We hope you take the time to explore our site further and perhaps catch the 'music bug' yourself, and become interested in getting to know this wonderful and educational hobby: making music together. No one is truly 'unmusical'—some are simply more musical than others.
